messages:
Nina (People Ops): Marina submitted resignation, last day 2026-07-09. International case: visa sponsorship ends on departure. Need visa offboarding steps, benefits end date, equity vesting proration, device return, and access cleanup. Raj can you coordinate KT?
Marina Costa: last day confirmed. My visa termination meeting is on 7/10 with immigration. Please send documents I need to hand to my lawyer. Also I prefer drop-off at the London office for the laptop.
Raj (Eng Manager): will run two 60-min KT sessions and a doc review. I'll list active services Marina owns and begin owner transfer.
Priya (IT): creating IT ticket IT-11500: schedule remote wipe + laptop intake at London desk 2026-07-09 17:30 BST. Will also prepare prepaid return label option if plans change.
Marco (Comp): equity note: Marina's RSUs will be prorated through last day per plan; comp will send the calculation and confirm cliff/vesting status. Expect an email with numbers by 7/12.
Alex (Security): security checklist: revoke Okta, remove SSH keys, rotate any infra tokens, disable VPN certs. For international case we need to confirm export-control access removal before departure.
Nina (People Ops): benefits: medical/dental/vision coverage ends 7/31 (month-end). COBRA packet (or local equivalent for UK) will go to marina.personal@mail.com on 7/10. If Marina elects continuation, payroll will send payment instructions.
Marina Costa: email is marina.personal@mail.com. On visa docs: I need a letter confirming last day and a statement of project access end date for Home Office; can People Ops provide?
Nina (People Ops): yes will provide the confirmation letter and a benefits termination certificate for your lawyer.
Raj (Eng Manager): I've created an ownership spreadsheet and tagged new owners for infra and repos; will DM Alex the service account list for rotations.
Oncall Bot: reminder queued: remove Marina from PagerDuty and remove group memberships at 17:35 BST on 2026-07-09.
Priya (IT): sample deprovision steps (internal):
```
# suspend account
oktactl update user marina.costa@redwood.ai suspended true
# revoke ssh keys
ssh-keygen -f /home/marina/.ssh/authorized_keys -R marina
```
Alex (Security): we'll perform KMS key rotation for any keys Marina accessed after compliance signs off on dataset exports.
Marco (Comp): also note: final payroll will include prorated salary and accrued PTO payout processed on next cycle; expensing timeline followed as usual.
Nina (People Ops): closing loop: People Ops to send visa/termination letters on 7/10, IT to run deprovision 7/09 17:30 BST, security to rotate tokens after repo handoff, comp to send equity calc. Please react with :white_check_mark: when tasks complete.
